First release of **WebOS Homebrew Fork**: [webOS Dev Manager](https://github.com/webosbrew/dev-manager-desktop) with an **Updates** tab for keeping homebrew apps on an LG webOS TV up to date.

### Updates tab
- **Add apps by link:** paste an app's GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg/Gitea/Forgejo repository. A link to a single `.ipk` file is refused, because it can't be tracked for new versions.
- **Update all:** one button installs every newer release with Dev Manager's installer (Homebrew Channel on rooted TVs, developer mode otherwise).
- **App page:** installed and latest versions, release date, source link, release notes, pre-release switch and an optional `.ipk` file filter.
- **Works with the TV off:** the list is kept in the app, one per TV. You can add apps any time, and versions and installs come back when the TV is on.

### Other changes from Dev Manager
- Its own name and app ID (`io.github.shantilk.weboshomebrewfork`), so it installs next to the official app.
- The update check and links point at this repository; crash reporting is off.

### Downloads
- **Android:** `WebOS.Homebrew.Fork_1.0.0_universal.apk`
- **Windows:** `.msi` (x64 and x86)
- **Linux:** `.deb`, `.rpm` and `.AppImage` (amd64 and arm64)
- **macOS:** universal `.dmg` (not notarized: right-click the app and choose Open the first time)

### Not tried yet
The Android app was tested on a Galaxy A36. The Windows, Linux and macOS builds come from the same code but weren't tried by hand.
